title: I'm back!  The piggies in my new flat with an even bigger cage!
description:
Hello I'm back!  
This is just a rather long video giving you an update on my pigs and their cage, and me!  I talk about hay for part of it - the most important part of your guinea pig's diet.  I will be ordering from dust free hay to provide my piggies with different sorts of hay! :) http://www.dustfreehay.co.uk/index.html

This is where I got the large log sticks from for £4: http://www.wcf.co.uk/country.aspx

MissCavyQueen's channel: http://www.youtube.com/user/MissCavyQueen

And finally my Etsy shop with new products in stock! http://www.etsy.com/shop/SqueakDreams?ref=top_trail
author: Piggles2810
